title: QIQT-H: a machine-checked Lean 4 / Mathlib development with an audited human-AI formalization loop
description: The Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of QIQT-H (Quantized Information Quantum Theory — Holographic), produced and audited by the human-directed two-model loop described in the accompanying methods paper. Every top-level theorem is audited with #print axioms; the development carries no sorry and the deductive core is project-axiom-free (it uses only Lean's standard axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). Includes the conditional, project-axiom-free derivation of the Einstein field equations (QIQTH.QiqtToGR.qiqt_bekenstein_gives_gr) with its machine-checked satisfiability witness, the no-collapse measurement core, the axiom-budget audit, the vacuity lint, the hypothesis-ledger / redundancy probe, and the goal-directed track-state report.
